unresolved.what: Region count reconciles: 6 colour regions + 6 city-bonus groups = 12 == catalog's 12.

DISAGREEMENT WITH THE TASK BRIEF: the brief lists 'Bull Mountain, King City, Ladd Hill, Saint Paul, Mulino, ...' as being in no region. I can only find THREE region-less territories on the artwork: Ladd Hill, Saint Paul and Mulino, which are the only three drawn with a neutral grey fill. Bull Mountain and King City are drawn with the same green fill as Tigard/Tualatin and sit inside the green region's single thick black outline; their labels are printed on the brown background west of their polygons, the same convention used for Metzger, Bridgeport, Fox Hill, N. Sherwood and S. Sherwood, all of which are unambiguously green. 11 green + 5 orange + 5 purple + 3 blue + 2 yellow + 6 red = 32, + 3 grey = 35 == the catalog's 35, which only balances if Bull Mountain and King City are green. I have therefore recorded them as green (region 1) and set that region's confidence to 'medium'. A human should re-check this one call before the fan-out; it is the single highest-value thing to resolve on this map.
None of the six colour regions carries a printed name; only the two legend panel titles ('Region Bonuses', 'Additional City Bonuses') are printed. All six colour-region 'name' fields are null.

The six city-bonus group names (Tigard, Tualatin, Lake Oswego, West Linn, Oregon City, Newberg) are NOT printed in the legend either. They are recorded because they are unambiguously implied by the pair of numbered territory names the white outline encloses, but they are inferred, not transcribed.

Colour regions and city-bonus groups OVERLAP: 12 territories belong both to a colour region and to a pairing (e.g. Tigard 1 is in region 1 and region 7). Any downstream consumer that assumes one region per territory will be wrong on this map.
Legend panel bboxes were read off the printed black frames at 4x zoom and are accurate to roughly +/-3 px.
